decompositions.name: Full A8 (control)
decompositions.principle: fast and slow layers with mutual additive coupling + neighbour interaction on both

decompositions.name: Fast removed (slow only)
decompositions.principle: drop fast layer; only slow evolves; u_final = u_slow

decompositions.name: Slow removed (fast only)
decompositions.principle: drop slow layer; only fast evolves; u_final = u_fast

decompositions.name: Fast frozen (slow evolves)
decompositions.principle: fast layer frozen at initial state; slow evolves normally

decompositions.name: Slow frozen (fast evolves)
decompositions.principle: slow layer frozen at initial state; fast evolves normally

decompositions.name: Fast->Slow coupling removed
decompositions.principle: only slow->fast coupling remains; fast does not feel slow

decompositions.name: Slow->Fast coupling removed
decompositions.principle: only fast->slow coupling remains; slow does not feel fast

decompositions.name: Bidirectional removed (independent)
decompositions.principle: no coupling; fast and slow evolve independently

decompositions.name: Coupling additive (no multiplicative)
decompositions.principle: pure additive coupling with full strength 1.0 on both sides

decompositions.name: Coupling multiplicative
decompositions.principle: coupling as product u_fast*u_slow instead of additive difference

decompositions.name: Neighbour interaction only on fast
decompositions.principle: fast updates include neighbour diff; slow updates contain only coupling term

decompositions.name: Neighbour interaction only on slow
decompositions.principle: slow updates include neighbour diff; fast updates contain only coupling term

decompositions.name: Neighbour interaction equally on both
decompositions.principle: equal weight neighbour term on both layers

decompositions.name: Layer update order reversed
decompositions.principle: slow updated first using old fast, then fast updated using new slow

decompositions.name: Timescales forced equal
decompositions.principle: removes timescale separation; both layers use same coefficient
